caption: Booking one appointment shouldn't take a whole afternoon of messages back and forth. If a customer could pick a time and be booked in with a single reply, how much of your week would you get back?

slides.headline: So many messages to book one appointment
Does Tuesday work for you?
slides.body: No, I'm out then. What about Wednesday? Sorry, I only just saw this.

slides.headline: The reply comes hours later.
slides.body: You're on a job. They're at work. Everyone's playing phone tag.

slides.headline: Some customers give up before it's booked.
slides.body: The easiest business to book is often the one that gets the job.

slides.headline: What if it only took one reply?
slides.body: Your agent offers free times, they pick one, and it lands in your calendar.

slides.headline: Same booking. Far fewer messages.
slides.body: You skip the back and forth and the customer is sorted straight away.
